item.title: Toyota of Scranton supports the Shamrock Heart Foundation
item.description: Toyota of Scranton aided the Shamrock Heart Foundation of Lackawanna County with financial support to help provide over 4,000 corsages and boutonnieres to local nursing home residents and hospital patients on March 17. The foundation’s volunteers have been brightening the lives of thousands of people in Lackawanna County for the last 32 years. item.description: Imagine a power structure under which a local police chief can sign a legal agreement with the federal government without the knowledge or input of elected officials or solicitors who are paid to evaluate potential liabilities for taxpayers.

item.title: PIAA WRESTLING: Martin builds off breakout season
item.description: Duke Martin had a breakout season last year, compiling a 43-13 record, capturing district gold and regional silver and qualifying for states. What would he do for an encore? The Honesdale junior wrestler didn’t disappoint. He is 46-6, the third-highest win total in District 2 this season behind Abington Heights’ Mason Whitney (48-6) and Martin’s teammate Nathan Schuman (47-1). item.title: NAMI Northeast PA talks with walking club participants in Scranton
item.description: NAMI Northeast Region PA staff and volunteers recently visited the Connell Park Walking Club hosted by Valley in Motion. The club, which often hosts guest speakers who share health and wellness information before the group walk through the park, welcomed NAMI representatives, from left, Ray Hayes, Mike Joyce and Amy Morgan. item.title: Pittston St. Patrick’s Parade marches on Saturday despite race cancellation
item.description: The first big NEPA St. Patrick's parade of the year is Saturday in Pittston. The traditional parade day race was canceled over the objections of parade organizers.
